item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Darren Hayes - Rare B-Sides, Covers & Unreleased Demos (Lossless/HQ)
item.description:
Hello everyone!

I'm hoping to track down several rare B-sides, unreleased demos, and covers by Darren Hayes. My goal is to get these in lossless (FLAC/ALAC) wherever commercially possible, or the highest quality available since some of these demos only exist as lower-quality MP3s.

Here is my list organized by era, including a little context on where each track originally comes from. If anyone has higher quality than me for these, I would be endlessly grateful!

After I collect everything I'll make a megapost of all his b-sides.

1. Spin Era (2002)


  • Do You Believe (Specificus ft. Darren Hayes) (Looking for better than 192 kbps) – Released on Specificus promo EP during the era.
  • Lift Me Up (Looking for better than 32 kbps) – Could be found on the Spin deluxe enhanced CD back in 2002. Solo demo of the later collaboration with Olivia Newton-John.
  • Ocean (Looking for better than 320 kbps) – Officially released later as a B-side to the digital single of "On the Verge of Something Wonderful", but known to originate from the Spin era.
  • When You Say You Love Me (Looking for better than 32 kbps) – Could be found on the Spin deluxe enhanced CD back in 2002. Solo demo of the later collaboration with Human Nature.
2. The Tension and the Spark Era (2004)


  • Let's Go (Looking for better than 320 kbps) – Originally an out-take from The Tension and the Spark, it was officially released later as a B-side to the physical single for "Me, Myself and (I)".
  • Timebomb (Looking for better than 128 kbps) – Unreleased demo from this album's recording sessions.
  • Touch (Looking for better than 320 kbps) – Official B-side to the physical CD single of "Pop!ular" in Australia, and "Darkness" in the UK. When ripped from streaming services, it is not a true lossless file.
3. This Delicate Thing We've Made Era (2007)


  • Breathless (Looking for better than 320 kbps) – Released as a B-side to the digital single of "Who Would Have Thought".
  • Every Little Thing (Looking for better than 320 kbps) – Released as a B-side to the digital single of "Me, Myself and (I)".
  • Fallen Angel (Looking for better than 320 kbps) – Released as a B-side to the physical single of "On the Verge of Something Wonderful".
  • God Is In the Room (Looking for better than 320 kbps) – Released as a B-side to the digital single of "On the Verge of Something Wonderful".
  • In Your Mother's Eyes (Looking for better than 320 kbps) – Released as a B-side to the digital single of "Casey".
  • Love Is In Everything (Looking for better than 128 kbps) – Bonus track on the iTunes EP for "On the Verge of Something Wonderful" and the iTunes album version. When ripped from digital streaming services it is not a true lossless file.
  • Slow Down (Looking for better than 320 kbps) – Released as a B-side to the physical single of "Me, Myself and (I)".
  • Tougher Than the Rest (Looking for better than 320 kbps) – Cover of the classic Bruce Springsteen song. It's origin is not known but I believe it's from this era.
4. Secret Codes and Battleships Era (2011)


  • Alive (Looking for better than 128 kbps) – Unreleased demo later pitched to Westlife.
  • Big Love (Looking for better than 320 kbps) – Unreleased demo later pitched to Kylie Minogue.
  • Breaking Up (Looking for better than 128 kbps) – Unreleased demo.
  • Dress You Up (Looking for better than 320 kbps) – Unreleased cover of Madonna's hit.
  • I Need You (Looking for better than 320 kbps) – Released as a B-side to the vinyl single of "Bloodstained Heart".
  • I Wanna Know (Looking for better than 128 kbps) – Unreleased demo.
  • No More Tears On the Dancefloor (Looking for better than 128 kbps) – Darren co-wrote this track, which later became the title track for Steps' 2017 album. This is his unreleased demo.
  • Without Your Love (Looking for better than 160 kbps) – Unreleased demo.
5. Homosexual Era (2022)


  • I Wish U Heaven (Looking for better than 320 kbps) – Prince cover released on the 2017 Prince tribute album. Not to be confused with Darren's 2002 live version.

Thank you so much in advance to anyone who can help me fill these gaps! Can't wait to share the Darren Hayes rarities megapost!
